gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent WHO Grade 4 Glioma
Recurrent World Health Organization (WHO) grade IV glioblastoma. Note: Any number of recurrences are allowable. Glioblastoma (GBM) variants and molecular GBM are allowed

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II trial tests how well retifanlimab with bevacizumab and hypofractionated radiotherapy, compared to bevacizumab and hypofractionated radiotherapy alone, works in treating patients with glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Retifanlimab with Bevacizumab and Hypofractionated Radiotherapy for the Treatment of Recurrent Glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the anti-glioma immune response before and after retifanlimab including assessment of immune cells phenotyping, function and activation in the pre-/post-treatment blood, and changes in cytokine levels over time.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive retifanlimab IV over 30 minutes on day 1 and bevacizumab IV on day 1 and 15 of each cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as retifanlimab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer, and may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive bevacizumab IV on day 1 and 15 of each cycle. Treatment repeats every 28 days for up to 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody; established GBM therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Bevacizumab is in a class of medications called antiangiogenic agents. It works by stopping the formation of blood vessels that bring oxygen and nutrients to tumor.

coder_notes: Arm B (bevacizumab + HFRT) is registered EXPERIMENTAL but is the control group per the primary objective ('vs. the control group treated with bevacizumab and HFRT'), so control_arm_from_other_arms = yes. Bevacizumab given identically in both arms -> soc_backbone. 'WHO grade IV glioblastoma' / 'WHO Grade 4 Glioma' with no IDH requirement -> historical. Target engagement coded yes on the correlative pre/post blood immune-response objective. Epacadostat is mentioned only in an exclusion (allergy) criterion and is not a registered intervention; dexamethasone only in eligibility; neither listed.
